title: Battery Packaging Market Expands as EV Gigafactories and Grid-Scale Energy Storage Reshape Protection Requirements
author: Sns Insider
description: The global battery packaging market is projected to grow from USD 39.8 billion in 2025 to USD 118.7 billion by 2035 at a CAGR of 11.57%, driven by electric vehicle production expansion, grid-scale energy storage deployment, and next-generation battery formats. Cardboard/paperboard dominates the material segment (61.23% share), while cylindrical packaging leads with prismatic growing fastest. Electric vehicles represent the fastest-growing end-use segment at 14.18% CAGR, with Asia Pacific holding 41.28% of global market share.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Listed as key competitor in growing battery packaging market with 11.57% CAGR expansion, positioned to benefit from increased demand across EV and energy storage sectors.

title: Europe Packaging Market to Reach USD 673.81 Billion by 2035, Driven by Sustainability Mandates, E-Commerce Expansion, and Advanced Packaging Technologies
author: Towards Packaging
description: Europe's packaging market is projected to grow from USD 473.41 billion in 2026 to USD 673.81 billion by 2035 at a 4% CAGR. Growth is driven by EU sustainability regulations, e-commerce expansion, and advanced packaging technologies. Western Europe leads the market while Eastern Europe shows fastest growth. Flexible packaging and compostable materials are emerging segments, with food & beverage and e-commerce sectors driving demand.
